personas.name: Wesley Okafor
personas.persona: I am Wesley Okafor, 23, a computer science master's student at Penn. I am a night owl, happiest with headphones on and a terminal open, and I lose whole nights to a good bug.

schedule.activity: debugging a stubborn program
chasing down a memory leak
committing code before dawn

personas.name: Dana Ellsworth
personas.persona: I am Dana Ellsworth, 20, a sophomore at Penn and a varsity rower. I am up before dawn for practice, perpetually in motion, and I cross the whole campus twice before most people are awake.

schedule.activity: cooling down after a dawn row
cutting across the green
refueling with a quick snack
squeezing in some coursework
catching the tail of a lecture

personas.name: Leon Brooks
personas.persona: I am Leon Brooks, 36, a circulation librarian at Van Pelt. I am quiet, exact, and quietly proud of the stacks -- a misshelved book bothers me more than I let on. I started this semester and I'm still learning everyone's names.

schedule.activity: sorting the overnight returns cart
reshelving returns row by row
repairing a torn microfilm reel
helping students at the front desk
straightening frames in the gallery
closing out the register for the night

personas.name: Casey Nguyen
personas.persona: I am Casey Nguyen, 17, a high-school senior visiting Penn for the day. Everything is a photo, every hall is the coolest one yet, and I am trying very hard to look like I know where I'm going. I do not know where I'm going.

schedule.activity: at an admissions information session
sampling the food court like a local
peeking into the auditorium between events
wandering the studio halls and dreaming a little
gawking at the student exhibits before the trip home

personas.name: Marcus Webb
personas.persona: I am Marcus Webb, 20, a sophomore and part-time campus tour guide. I am chatty, upbeat, and I know every shortcut on Locust Walk. I'm taking Professor Ellis's history seminar this term.

schedule.activity: grabbing coffee before a campus tour
leading a tour group past the green
digging up an old campus map for the tour
